description: This TypeScript file defines an Angular component named HeaderComponent, which renders the application's header with navigation links, user authentication controls, and responsiveness behavior.

classes.name: HeaderComponent
classes.description: Angular component responsible for rendering and managing the application's header, including navigation links, user sign-in/sign-out, and responsive behavior.

methods.name: toggleMobileNav
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the mobile navigation drawer.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the current user is authenticated.

methods.name: displayName
methods.description: Computes the display name for the signed-in user based on available user data.

methods.name: loading
methods.description: Reactive signal indicating the current loading state during authentication processes.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Initiates the sign-in process using Google OAuth.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Window resize event handler that closes mobile navigation if the viewport expands beyond a certain width.

ctags.name: canCheck
ctags.pattern: /^    const canCheck = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && typeof (globalThis as any).matchMedia /
